title: The Light Between Oceans
author: M. L. Stedman
summary: After the First World War, a lighthouse keeper and his wife live in isolation on a remote Australian island, grieving their lost pregnancies. When a boat washes ashore with a baby, they make a choice that will change many lives.
readIf: you like emotional novels that dwell on a moral dilemma where nobody is simply right or wrong.
skipIf: you want to avoid stories about miscarriage, infant loss and parental grief.

pairings.reason: Another novel where a single decision made in the heat of the moment reshapes people's lives after a war.
Another family drama driven by an agonising ethical choice and a legal fallout.
A quieter, more restrained story of a life shaped by duty and the things left unsaid.
